excerpts.text:
The -json flag causes the package data to be printed in JSON format
instead of using the template format. The JSON flag can optionally be
provided with a set of comma-separated required field names to be output.
If so, those required fields will always appear in JSON output, but
others may be omitted to save work in computing the JSON struct.

The -compiled flag causes list to set CompiledGoFiles to the Go source

cachedBuild := false
	needCovMeta := p.Internal.Cover.GenMeta
	need := bit(needBuild, !b.IsCmdList && buildAction.needBuild || b.NeedExport) |
		bit(needCgoHdr, b.needCgoHdr(buildAction)) |
		bit(needVet, buildAction.needVet) |
		bit(needCovMetaFile, needCovMeta) |
		bit(needCompiledGoFiles, b.NeedCompiledGoFiles)

observations: The -json= option accepts a fixed top-level field list.
The encoder clears only unrequested top-level fields; Module remains the full nested value.
All three requested Embed fields retain embed collection.
DepsErrors remains computed when Deps is omitted.
Omitted Stale/StaleReason avoids the unconsumed cache/build-info path.
IsCmdList without NeedExport suppresses actual build outputs.
